boi.summary: Beneficial ownership (BOI) reports are not listed. FinCEN's final rule, effective August 14, 2026, keeps companies created in the United States out of the reporting rule. A foreign company registered to do business in the United States can still have a report. This app does not list that foreign-company case.
boi.sourceLabel: FinCEN final rule, Federal Register, August 14, 2026

deadlines.title: Florida annual report late-fee date
deadlines.detail: Sunbiz says a profit corporation, LLC, limited partnership, or limited liability limited partnership has until 11:59 p.m. Eastern on Friday, May 1, 2026 before the $400 late fee. deadlines.sourceLabel: Florida Division of Corporations, Sunbiz annual report

deadlines.sourceLabel: North Carolina Secretary of State, annual report due dates

deadlines.title: North Carolina LLP annual report
deadlines.detail: The Secretary of State says an LLP or LLLP report is due the 15th day of the fourth month after the fiscal year ends. For a calendar year that is April 15. Turn this off if you are an LLC using the April 15 LLC row, or if your year does not end December 31.
deadlines.sourceLabel: North Carolina Secretary of State, annual report due dates

deadlines.title: New York general business corporation franchise tax
deadlines.detail: For a tax year that began in 2025, the Department of Taxation and Finance says a calendar-year Article 9-A return is due on or before April 15. A Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday moves it to the next business day. April 15, 2026 is a Wednesday. That page does not cover a tax year that began in 2026.
deadlines.sourceLabel: New York Tax Department, Article 9-A franchise tax

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania corporation annual report
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says a business or nonprofit corporation, domestic or foreign, files from January 1 through June 30 each year.

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania corporation annual report
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says a business or nonprofit corporation, domestic or foreign, files from January 1 through June 30 each year.

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania LLC annual report
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says a domestic or foreign LLC files from January 1 through September 30. Turn this off if you are a sole proprietor and not an LLC, or if you are a partnership using the December 31 row.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Pennsylvania Department of State, annual reports

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania LLC annual report
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says a domestic or foreign LLC files from January 1 through September 30. Turn this off if you are a sole proprietor and not an LLC, or if you are a partnership using the December 31 row.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Pennsylvania Department of State, annual reports

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania annual report for a partnership or similar association
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says a limited partnership, limited liability partnership, business trust, or professional association files by December 31. Turn this off if you are an LLC using the September 30 row.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Pennsylvania Department of State, annual reports

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania annual report for a partnership or similar association
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says a limited partnership, limited liability partnership, business trust, or professional association files by December 31. Turn this off if you are an LLC using the September 30 row.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Pennsylvania Department of State, annual reports

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania certificate of annual registration
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says an LLP, LLLP, or restricted professional company still files a certificate of annual registration on or before April 15. This is separate from the annual report. Turn this off if you are not one of those entities.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Pennsylvania Department of State, annual reports

deadlines.title: Pennsylvania certificate of annual registration
deadlines.detail: The Department of State says an LLP, LLLP, or restricted professional company still files a certificate of annual registration on or before April 15. This is separate from the annual report. Turn this off if you are not one of those entities.

deadlines.title: Rhode Island annual report
deadlines.detail: The Department of State lists a filing period of February 1 to May 1 for an LLC, business corporation, LP, or LLP. This row uses May 1, the last day of that period. Turn this off if you are a sole proprietor and not one of those entities.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Rhode Island Department of State, annual report

deadlines.title: Rhode Island annual report
deadlines.detail: The Department of State lists a filing period of February 1 to May 1 for an LLC, business corporation, LP, or LLP. May 1, 2027 is a Saturday. That page does not say to move the date. Turn this off if you are a sole proprietor and not one of those entities.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Rhode Island Department of State, annual report

deadlines.title: Texas franchise tax report for 2026
deadlines.detail: The Comptroller says 2026 franchise tax reports are due May 15, 2026. A sole proprietorship does not file, except a single-member LLC does. A general partnership owned only by people does not file, except a limited liability partnership does. Turn this off if one of those exceptions is you. Publication 98-806 lists who files.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Texas Comptroller, franchise tax

deadlines.title: Texas franchise tax report for 2027
deadlines.detail: The Comptroller says the report is due May 15, and if May 15 falls on a weekend or holiday the due date is the next business day. May 15, 2027 is a Saturday, so this row uses May 17, 2027. The same who-must-file exceptions as 2026 apply. Turn this off if you are in an exception.
deadlines.sourceLabel: Texas Comptroller publication 98-806
